# Outlio Developer Resources

## Product: Outlio
## Version: 0.1.0
## Description: B2B lead intelligence SaaS - research-first outbound sales system

## API Documentation
- Base URL: https://outlio.io/api
- Authentication: Bearer token via Supabase edge functions
- Main endpoints:
  - /api/intelligence/query - Intelligence queries
  - /api/hubble/ask - Hubble AI questions
  - /api/extension/* - Extension management
  - /api/integrations/* - Third-party integrations
  - /api/webhooks/* - Webhook handlers

## Authentication
- Supabase JWT tokens
- OAuth where applicable
- API keys for external services

## MCP Server
- Context: Outlio MCP client integration
- Purpose: Agent-to-agent communication for lead intelligence

## Webhooks
- FastSpring webhook handler: /api/webhooks/fastspring
- Payment events and status updates

## Search & Discovery
- Site map: https://outlio.io/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://outlio.io/robots.txt
- Brand name: Outlio
- Primary domain: outlio.io

## Contact
- Email: hello@outlio.io
- Support: https://outlio.io/contact

## Key Features
- Research-first outbound sales
- Human-written messaging
- Shared CRM with live KPIs
- Lead engine for B2B intelligence
- Multi-channel outreach (LinkedIn, email, X)

## Integrations
- Supabase (database & auth)
- Google Calendar (booking)
- FastSpring (payments)
- Various AI providers (Gemini, Groq, Cerebras)

## Deployment
- Platform: Vercel
- Domain: outlio.io
- Environment: .env.local configuration

## License
- Proprietary source code
- Free-tier friendly policy: OUTLIO_ALLOW_PAID_PROVIDERS=false by default
